strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the level of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs after sell-side liquidity is grabbed, and for shorts after buy-side liquidity is grabbed.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity-grab wick/level. Take profit at the most recent opposing swing level: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples shown on mixed charts
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Directly use the candle that made the liquidity grab as the entry reference
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent swing high/low
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Wait for the indicator's marked entry signal after it identifies the liquidity grab
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent swing high/low

consensus.enumeration_note: The video teaches one reversal skeleton only; mentions of 10-candle spacing, divergence, and higher-timeframe support/resistance are confluence filters to improve the same strategy, not separate strategies.

strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the first step we are looking for what's called a liquidity grab
entry_sequence.action: Identify a liquidity grab where price breaks support or resistance, fakes out, and reverses in the opposite direction.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup starts with a false break that signals a reversal.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: it can be either sell-side liquidity or buy side liquidity
entry_sequence.action: For longs, use a sell-side liquidity grab below support; for shorts, use a buy-side liquidity grab above resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker teaches the setup symmetrically on both sides.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: your entry would be at the candle that made the liquidity grab
entry_sequence.action: Mark the entry at the liquidity-grab candle: for longs at the candle that swept below support, and for shorts at the candle that swept above resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: The entry is anchored to the candle that initiated the grab.

strategies.preferred_regime: at the absolute top or bottom of the range

stop.transcript_quote: set your stop loss right right below the liquidity grab
stop.rationale: The stop goes just beyond the liquidity grab.

targets.transcript_quote: you're going to set your take profit at a recent high
targets.rationale: For longs, the profit target is a recent high.

targets.transcript_quote: setad her take profit at a recent low
targets.rationale: For shorts, the profit target is a recent low.

confluences.transcript_quote: if the liquidity grab and and the entry candle were closer than 10 candles apart
confluences.name: peaks_closer_than_10_candles
confluences.description: The speaker says entries perform better when the liquidity grab and entry candle are closer than 10 candles apart.

confluences.name: divergence
confluences.description: The speaker improves the setup by adding divergence as confluence.

confluences.transcript_quote: it works best if you're finding reversals at the bottoms or tops of big moves
confluences.name: reversal_at_range_extreme
confluences.description: The strategy works best at the tops or bottoms of larger moves rather than in the middle.

confluences.transcript_quote: happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame
confluences.name: higher_timeframe_support_resistance
confluences.description: The lower-timeframe signal is stronger when it aligns with higher-timeframe support or resistance.
